label: Ship Cannon
note: IP-neutral. Fixed forward ship gun; 'mag' + 'reload_time' act as a heat limit. Issue #64: in the atmosphere a bolt bursts where it lands (on the ground too), hurting everything within splash_radius by splash_damage, so strafing people on the ground works. 'damage' is what a hit does to a ship's hull (the same in the air and in space); 'personnel_damage' what a hit does to anything else (people, droids, beasts, speeders), so a direct hit kills most troopers outright, the cruiser's too. Both are times the ship's blaster_power.
